### SASA 2026 Conference
<p class="event-meta">23 – 27 November 2026 · Hosted by the University of the Witwatersrand · Birchwood Hotel and OR Tambo Conference Centre, Johannesburg</p>

The 67th annual conference of the South African Statistical Association. The programme opens with two days of workshops facilitated by invited speakers from national and international institutions, followed by the three-day conference.

[Conference website](https://sasaconference2026.org/){.btn-sasa}
:::
:::
